headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / The Hindu / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: Call for human chain at Tank Bund to demand scrapping of SIR.
BCI stays Telangana Bar Council’s constitution of committees.
Police permission sought for over 60 RSS marches across Bengaluru.
Seat-Sharing Disputes Trouble Alliance in Urban Local Body Polls.
bullets_ur: SIR khatam karne ka mutalba karne ke liye Tank Bund par insani zanjeer banane ki apil.
BCI ne Telangana Bar Council ki committees ki tashkeel par stay de diya.
Bengaluru mein 60 se zyada RSS marches ke liye police se ijazat mangi gayi.
Local body elections mein seat-sharing ke tanazaat ne alliance ko pareshani mein daal diya.
